findings.summary: ADR decision: Option C (single source data/AGENTS.md, generated to four projection roots at install time). Parity becomes a structural property, not a process property.
FR7.11 wording must be revised under Option C: manifest tracks only data/AGENTS.md, not data/CLAUDE.md. PE must update SPEC text when authoring PLAN.

decisions_required: PE: revise FR7.11 wording in SPEC to reflect single-source manifest model under Option C
PE: specify consumer-repo slug discovery contract in PLAN (recommended: presence of .dadaia/ marker)
PE: include explicit operator-visible parity line in doctor output even though structurally redundant
PE: include nested-pair (services/CLAUDE.md) safety test in TASKS to verify lib installer does not hash-lock nested files

next_handoff.input: ADR for FR7.0 finalized — Option C selected (single source data/AGENTS.md projected to four roots). PE: use this ADR while writing PLAN.md for release agents-r2-v1; reconcile FR7.11 wording; specify consumer-repo slug discovery; emit doctor parity line per root.
